integrity.priority_uncertainty: Earlier unindexed descriptions of annular spectral ordering cannot be ruled out.

scientific_limitations: The result concerns the one-dimensional Gaussian Fock model and concentric fixed-area annuli; nonradial symbols, other windows and higher dimensions are not addressed.
The two asymptotic regimes fix s,N or k,N, respectively; no simultaneous large-parameter uniformity is claimed.
The basic radial diagonalization and the special equality radius A_{0,1}(s)=s/(exp(s)-1) were known. Earlier unindexed mode-ordering descriptions may overlap.
title: Ranked spectral staircase and sharp hole thresholds for Gaussian annuli
